notes.title: Night Shift - Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[h2]Calling Night Shifters![/h2]

[h3]We are thrilled to announce that Night Shift is launching on June 24th, 2025![/h3]

[previewyoutube=b8Glhb9zz4E;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]You are working the night shift in a pizza store.[/h3]

Feeling hungry? Our pizza will make you never hungry again. Apply today for the prestigious Night Shift at our beloved 24/7 pizza parlor. Clean up, clock in, survive.

[list]
[*]🍕Hand out pizza to the night delivery crew.
[*]🗑️Take out the trash before something else does.
[*]🪑Put the chairs up on the tables. You’ll want a clear line of sight.
[/list]

It’s just three nights. Just you, the pizza, and whatever that was in the corner of your eye. If you survive, you get paid. If you don’t… hey, you won’t be hungry anymore.
